selection_rule: pass every frozen semantic and negative gate, then choose the smallest depth

post_fix_regression.qualification: post-fix regression; exact callsite requests were derived from the retained raw traces

operational_semantics.endpoint_handling: retain candidates to D=4; the current evaluator verifies that a reviewed semantic endpoint is present but the extractor does not stop automatically
operational_semantics.stack_scope: only exact function and source-line frames retained in the crash stack
operational_semantics.temporal_scope: definitions after the fault or after the retained caller callsite are rejected
operational_semantics.source_gate: abstain when the CPG access is hidden by a macro and is not visible in the retained source line
operational_semantics.uaf: static operand/provenance candidates are combined with raw ASan allocation/free facts, but those runtime facts do not select D

validation_panel.result_at_d4: all five resolved source-level expressions; no post-fault local definition was selected
validation_panel.selection_role: regression only; old assertion oracle was not used to select D

claim_limit: This fixes the maximum depth for the next pilot. Six selection cases and one post-fix regression panel are too weak to claim a universal optimum or start the full experiment before endpoint selection is implemented.
